newsitem.title: USA: United Vanguard hikes IPO pricing terms.
newsitem.headline: United Vanguard hikes IPO pricing terms.

text.p: United Vanguard Homes Inc has raised the estimated price range for its upcoming initial public offering, according to regulatory filings.
In a filing, the estimated price range per share was raised to $7.50 to $9.50 a share. In July, the IPO had been estimated to price at $6.50 to $8 a share.

United Vanguard owns and manages senior living facilities which provide housing various levels of care and services. It will offer 1.8 million shares of common stock and 1.8 million common stock purchase warrants.
Janney Montgomery Scott is the lead underwriter of the offering, which is tentatively scheduled for the week of October 14.
